headline_note: The locked KPI (10,000 free scans / 1,000 paid / $120k ARR by 2027-08-01) is the headline and is not changed or computed here. These four are secondary.

m1_activated_scans_per_week.definition: Completed web scans with at least one found result, per Hong Kong (ISO) week; test mailbox left out.

current_week.reason: No stored non-test scan for this week, so 0 here is a lower bound, not a measurement: deleted scans cannot be dated to the week they were made (see coverage).

last_complete_week.reason: No stored non-test scan for this week, so 0 here is a lower bound, not a measurement: deleted scans cannot be dated to the week they were made (see coverage).

caveats: Counts the web scans still stored. A deleted scan leaves only an undated counter, so any week is a lower bound (see coverage).
Test-mailbox scans are left out, but only while the linked scans row still exists to prove it.

m2_verified_facts_per_completed_scan.definition: Median, per completed web scan, of hexagons found or checked-and-clear (distinct registry hexagons), per Hong Kong week; scans with none count as 0; test mailbox left out.

current_week.reason: No stored completed scan in this week, so there is no median (not 0).

last_complete_week.reason: No stored completed scan in this week, so there is no median (not 0).

caveats: Counts the web scans still stored. A deleted scan leaves only an undated counter, so any week is a lower bound (see coverage).
Test-mailbox scans are left out, but only while the linked scans row still exists to prove it.

m3_calibrated_tiles_per_month.definition: Tiles whose confidence_config value was changed and then validated by 30+ follow-up responders (95% Wilson interval contains the new value), per Hong Kong month, counted in the month the 30th responder arrived.
m3_calibrated_tiles_per_month.reason: Zero is the expected value: only confidence_config version 0 (the registry numbers) exists, so no tile has been recalibrated. The learning loop is dormant; this is reported, not worked around.
m3_calibrated_tiles_per_month.note: No tile answer (yes, not me, disputed, kept) has been recorded either: the browser sends no person key since MPC-9892 and public.mpt_hexagon_events is empty, so a version bump alone could not be validated yet.

g_dispute_rate_on_high_confidence.definition: Disputes on high-confidence tiles (confidence in force above 0.8) / high-confidence tiles shown with a dispute prompt, per Hong Kong week. answered_dispute_rate divides by responders instead. NULL, never 0%, when nobody has answered.

current_week.reason: No tile answer was recorded this week, so there is nothing to divide: no dispute rate (not 0%).

last_complete_week.reason: No tile answer was recorded this week, so there is nothing to divide: no dispute rate (not 0%).

caveats: High confidence is the confidence in force today (active confidence_config, else the registry); the counters carry neither the confidence nor the config version.
Shown counts tiles offered an answer, not every finding; with silence common, read the rate beside response_rate.

coverage.note: Scans already deleted are not in M1/M2 and cannot be dated to the week they were made. They are listed by week of deletion; test scans are not separated.
